interpretation: Consistent joint point-estimate improvement on reused development audit.
claims_allowed: Six frozen new RF fits, identical train/tune/audit rows and fixed hyperparameters, test one six-feature block.
All three RF seeds improved Scratch true positives and reduced both normal-to-Scratch and total normal false positives on this reused development audit.
Point-estimate improvement is consistent across seeds; it does not establish statistical significance for every seed or independent generalization.
PCA anisotropy is recoverable from the original covariance: the empirical redundancy audit spans all 54355 development wafers.
Feature/error associations, gallery impressions and size-coverage concentrations are descriptive, not proven causes.
claims_not_supported: A new independent test success, production readiness, or replacement of the original final model.
Six independent new information sources, or an isolated causal effect of PCA.
Three seeds triple the number of independent evaluation wafers.
A controlled CPU-versus-GPU latency benchmark or a claim that all Scratch recall weaknesses are solved.
